run_render_tensorflow_stubs: run the script to render a Jinja template for TensorFlow library type stubs into tensorflow_stubs.pyi
build_tensorflow_type_stubs: build TensorFlow library type stubs by rendering a Jinja2 template with reduction and transpose axis helpers
test_axis_list: test the axis_list function that returns comma-separated axis TypeVar short names like 'A1, A2'
review_reduction_axes: review the reduction_axes generator that yields ReductionAxes objects for each possible reduction of an n-dimensional array
summarize_transpose_axes: summarize the transpose_axes generator that yields TransposeAxes objects encoding all possible transposes of an n-dimensional array
